title: Auto-fetch refresh bug fix - fetch policy, portfolio manual refresh, deleted-ISIN cleanup
derived_from: Locked fetch policy from discussion #272 (Stage 1 G1 closed) - developer confirmed 2026-11-16; documentation only, zero new decisions (Stage 2 rule)

requirements.text: On first app open after install, the system SHALL run an immediate background bond-master refresh for all known ISINs (empty cache, warm everything).

acceptance_criteria.given: a fresh install with no bond_master cache
acceptance_criteria.when: the app starts for the first time
acceptance_criteria.then: one background refresh pass runs immediately for all known ISINs from both surfaces

requirements.text: After the first run, auto-fetch SHALL run at most ONCE per 12-hour window — only when the app opens AFTER the window elapsed.

acceptance_criteria.given: the last_auto_fetch timestamp is 6 hours ago
the last_auto_fetch timestamp is 13 hours ago

requirements.text: Each auto-fetch pass SHALL cover ALL known ISINs from BOTH surfaces (watchlist + portfolio) in a single background pass — the cache is one shared bond_master table keyed by ISIN, no split.

acceptance_criteria.given: known ISINs exist in both watchlist candidates and portfolio bonds
acceptance_criteria.then: all ISINs are refreshed in one pass with no surface distinction

requirements.text: The auto-fetch SHALL NEVER run twice within the 12-hour window no matter how many restarts — the last_auto_fetch timestamp is PERSISTED IN THE DATABASE (survives restarts, fixes the in-memory bug).

acceptance_criteria.given: an auto-fetch ran 2 hours ago and the app is restarted 3 times
acceptance_criteria.then: zero additional auto-fetch runs occur; the persisted last_auto_fetch is unchanged

acceptance_criteria.given: the app is killed and restarted after 13 hours
acceptance_criteria.then: one auto-fetch runs and last_auto_fetch is updated to the new time

requirements.text: Manual refresh SHALL refresh the specific bond(s) the user is viewing (per-ISIN, immediate), bypassing the 12h auto window but keeping the 60s anti-double-tap cooldown.

acceptance_criteria.given: the user taps manual refresh on a portfolio bond while the 12h auto window is active
acceptance_criteria.then: the specific ISIN refreshes immediately; the 60s cooldown applies; the 12h auto timer is NOT reset

requirements.text: Manual refresh SHALL NOT reset the auto 12h timer — the two are independent (a manual per-bond refresh must not starve the rest of the portfolio of auto refreshes).

acceptance_criteria.given: manual refresh runs for ISIN A at hour 6 of the 12h window
acceptance_criteria.when: the auto window elapses at hour 12
acceptance_criteria.then: the auto-fetch pass still runs at hour 12; the manual refresh did not shift the window

requirements.text: Within the 7-day staleness window, manual refresh SHALL ask confirm "already fetched <date> - refresh anyway?".

acceptance_criteria.then: a confirmation dialog shows the fetched date and asks to proceed

requirements.text: After 7 days of staleness, manual refresh SHALL just refresh (no confirm).

acceptance_criteria.then: the refresh runs immediately with no confirmation dialog

requirements.text: Two timestamps SHALL be maintained in the database: (1) last_auto_fetch — global, persisted (new column/table); (2) fetched_at — per ISIN, already exists in bond_master.

acceptance_criteria.then: last_auto_fetch column/table exists and is populated on each auto-fetch pass; bond_master.fetched_at is updated per ISIN on every fetch

requirements.text: Portfolio manual refresh control SHALL mirror Watchlist /watch/refresh (watch.py:648): per-ISIN Refresh control on each Portfolio row, same 60s cooldown, same 7-day confirm behavior, bypasses 12h auto window.

acceptance_criteria.given: a portfolio bond row is displayed
acceptance_criteria.when: the user taps its refresh icon
acceptance_criteria.then: the per-ISIN refresh runs with 60s cooldown, 7-day confirm, and bypasses the 12h auto window

acceptance_criteria.given: the portfolio refresh endpoint is called
acceptance_criteria.then: it mirrors the watchlist refresh contract: same states, same error codes, same provenance update

requirements.text: Deleted-ISIN cleanup trigger: when a watchlist candidate or bond is deleted, its cached bond_master record SHALL be marked so the 12h auto-fetch pass skips it. Cleanup runs on the delete operation.

acceptance_criteria.given: a watchlist candidate with ISIN X is deleted
acceptance_criteria.then: the bond_master record for ISIN X is marked (e.g., deleted flag or removed from auto-fetch set)

acceptance_criteria.given: a portfolio bond with ISIN Y is deleted
acceptance_criteria.then: ISIN Y is not included in the refresh pass

prd_items.statement: The system SHALL run an immediate background bond-master refresh for all known ISINs on the first app open after install (empty cache warm-up).
The system SHALL run auto-fetch at most once per 12-hour window after the first run, only when the app opens after the window elapsed.
The system SHALL cover all known ISINs from both watchlist and portfolio surfaces in a single background auto-fetch pass using the shared bond_master table.
The system SHALL persist the last_auto_fetch timestamp in the database so auto-fetch never runs twice within the 12h window across restarts.
The system SHALL allow manual per-ISIN refresh that bypasses the 12h auto window but respects the 60s cooldown.
The system SHALL keep manual and auto refresh timers independent — manual refresh must not reset the auto 12h timer.
The system SHALL show a staleness confirmation dialog for manual refresh within 7 days of the last fetch.
The system SHALL skip the staleness confirmation for manual refresh after 7 days of staleness.
The system SHALL maintain last_auto_fetch (global, persisted) and fetched_at (per ISIN, existing in bond_master) in the database.
The system SHALL provide per-ISIN manual refresh on Portfolio rows mirroring the Watchlist /watch/refresh contract (watch.py:648).
The system SHALL mark deleted ISINs in bond_master so the 12h auto-fetch pass skips them, with cleanup triggered on the delete operation.

test_cases.title: First-run auto-fetch fires immediately (AFR-01)
test_cases.steps: 1. Clear bond_master cache. 2. Start app. 3. Inspect bond_master after startup.
test_cases.expected: One background pass ran for all known ISINs; bond_master populated with fetched_at timestamps

test_cases.title: 12-hour auto window respected (AFR-02, AFR-04)
test_cases.steps: 1. Set last_auto_fetch to 6h ago. 2. Restart app 3 times. 3. Set last_auto_fetch to 13h ago. 4. Restart app.
test_cases.expected: Zero auto-fetches at 6h; one auto-fetch at 13h; last_auto_fetch persisted across restarts

test_cases.title: Single pass covers both surfaces (AFR-03)
test_cases.steps: 1. Seed known ISINs in watchlist candidates and portfolio bonds. 2. Trigger auto-fetch. 3. Inspect adapter call order.
test_cases.expected: All ISINs refreshed in one pass; no surface distinction in the pass

test_cases.title: Manual refresh bypasses 12h window, keeps 60s cooldown (AFR-05, AFR-06)
test_cases.steps: 1. Set last_auto_fetch to 2h ago. 2. Manual refresh ISIN A. 3. Wait 10h (total 12h). 4. Check auto-fetch still runs.
test_cases.expected: Manual refresh runs immediately; 60s cooldown applies; auto-fetch still runs at 12h mark

test_cases.title: 7-day staleness confirm dialog (AFR-07, AFR-08)
test_cases.steps: 1. Set fetched_at to 3 days ago. 2. Tap manual refresh - assert confirm dialog with date. 3. Set fetched_at to 8 days ago. 4. Tap manual refresh - assert no dialog.
test_cases.expected: Confirm shown at 3 days with fetched date; no confirm at 8 days

test_cases.title: Timestamps in database (AFR-09)
test_cases.steps: 1. Run auto-fetch pass. 2. Query last_auto_fetch table/column. 3. Query bond_master.fetched_at per ISIN.
test_cases.expected: last_auto_fetch populated with pass timestamp; each refreshed ISIN has updated fetched_at

test_cases.title: Portfolio manual refresh mirrors Watchlist (AFR-10)
test_cases.steps: 1. Tap refresh on a portfolio row. 2. Inspect endpoint, states, error codes, provenance. 3. Compare to watch.py:648 contract.
test_cases.expected: Same endpoint shape, same 60s cooldown, same 7-day confirm, same 12h bypass, same states/error codes/provenance

test_cases.title: Watchlist candidate delete marks bond_master (AFR-11)
test_cases.steps: 1. Delete a watchlist candidate with ISIN X. 2. Inspect bond_master for ISIN X. 3. Run auto-fetch pass. 4. Assert ISIN X skipped.
test_cases.expected: ISIN X marked/removed from auto-fetch set; next auto-fetch pass skips it

test_cases.title: Portfolio bond delete marks bond_master (AFR-11)
test_cases.steps: 1. Delete a portfolio bond with ISIN Y. 2. Inspect bond_master for ISIN Y. 3. Run auto-fetch pass. 4. Assert ISIN Y skipped.
test_cases.expected: ISIN Y marked/removed from auto-fetch set; next auto-fetch pass skips it

test_cases.title: Staleness cue on Portfolio rows and bond detail (AFR-07, AFR-08)
test_cases.steps: 1. Set fetched_at to 8 days ago for a portfolio bond. 2. Open Portfolio page. 3. Open bond detail page.
test_cases.expected: Staleness indicator shown next to provenance on both Portfolio row and bond detail page (not global header)
